cohort: 40 primiparous women aged 20-35 years, with a BMI < 30 kg/m^2 and waist/hip ratio > 0.85, complaining of SIJ dysfunction, recruited from an outpatient clinic.
finding: A 6-week exercise program including muscle energy techniques, core stability exercises, and pelvic floor exercises improved SIJ pain and asymmetry in postpartum women.
mod_finding: Women who delivered vaginally showed greater improvement in pain severity, pelvic asymmetry, and pain threshold compared to those who delivered via cesarean section.
